options.text: It scales each step along the negative gradient, controlling step size
options.rationale: Correct: too large overshoots, too small is slow.

options.text: It sets the number of parameters in the model
options.rationale: The learning rate does not change model size.

options.text: It guarantees reaching the global minimum
